sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Location/Area splitting (`_routeAreaLink()`/`_maybeCorrectAreaFlagRegion()`): when a "More Flags Everywhere"-decorated area link's bare anchor text collides with a DIFFERENT entity's name (e.g. MusicBrainz's own area "New York" the city vs. area "New York" the state both render bare "New York"), the city was wrongly force-routed into the "Region" column alongside the state instead of staying in "Locality". Fixed via new `_flagIconSubdivisionLabel()`, which reads the decorating icon's own disambiguated `alt`/`title` (e.g. "New York City") instead of the anchor's own ambiguous text.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown "Entity info" `» name:` family: when two DISTINCT MusicBrainz entities share the exact same display name on one column (e.g. the area-name collision above), a single flat `» name: New York` entry used to silently match BOTH real-world entities with no way to isolate either. Split into one entry per underlying href instead (`New York (1)`/`New York (2)`, …), each independently selectable via a new href-scoped `namehref:` compound filter mode — new `_emitNameSynItem()`, `_findCellEntityCommentParts()`'s added `href` field, and matching `_cellMatchesStructureMode()`/`_highlightEntityCommentPartMatch()`/`_structureModeLabel()`/`_structureModeTooltip()` branches.
